messages:
alex: Heads-up - hosted API is seeing a wave of 5xxs starting ~09:12 UTC, p50 latency up too. Lots of customer repros coming in. Anyone on?

maria: I'm on. seeing 503/502 mix, spike at the edge + gateway. graphs show a fanout from inference-gateway.

sre-oncall: Jumping in. pulling livetrace for one of the impacted requests.

alex: repro from a customer payload attached in support ticket — small prompt, not huge tokens. hits start failing after ~200ms of processing.

julian: quick check — is this the KV cache warmup we saw last month? pattern looks different, though.

emily: looks like connection resets from the runtime pool; I see `connection_reset` in the runtime logs and a burst of `503` at the gateway.

opsbot: autoscaler alert: CPU on pool-inference-3 at 92%, pending pods queueing.

maria: confirmed autoscaler delayed by cooldown, scale-up didn't trigger fast enough. starting manual scale now (+2 replicas).

alex: manual scale accepted. can we temporarily increase max-inflight on the gateway to avoid queuing?

julian: doing `gatewayctl set-route --path /v1/generate --max-inflight 200` now.

emily: gateway change applied. I'm also toggling prefix-KV caching to aggressive for this route to reduce per-token work (will monitor).

support-bot: Noted impacted customers: cust-apple, cust-skyline (tickets #1421, #1422). Sent a holding update to both.

alex: any signs of auth/billing correlation? customers reported billing errors earlier.

maria: billing API returned 502 for a small subset around the same window. looks like a downstream throttle on billing-proxy. probably exacerbated the request queue.

julian: mitigation plan so far: 1) manual scale +2, 2) increase gateway max-inflight, 3) aggressive KV cache, 4) temporary traffic-shift to a healthy region for sensitive customers.

emily: started traffic-shift for cust-apple to eu-west-1 instance. validation ok, no quality diff.

sre-oncall: p90 latency dropping but 5xx still present at low rate. pulling runtime stack traces for failing requests.

alex: logs show `HttpTimeoutError` from the auth-proxy on some flows. Maria can you check token refresh/latency with KMS?

maria: KMS latencies are normal. auth-proxy shows a small retry storm — our circuit breaker tripped and then some requests fell through as 500. rolling back the last config change to auth-proxy (reduced concurrency) to see if it stabilizes.

opsbot: rollback complete. auth-proxy error rate decreasing. overall 5xx rate down ~65% from peak.

alex: great. action items: julian to follow up on autoscaler cooldown tuning (owner: julian), emily to write quick KB for traffic-shift steps for support (owner: emily), maria to investigate billing-proxy throttle spikes and add guardrails (owner: maria). I'll draft a short customer-facing blurb for affected accounts.

julian: putting autoscaler cooldown and surge detection on my backlog — will PR tomorrow AM.

emily: KB draft in #docs-devex, will ping support.

maria: opening postmortem ticket and scheduling follow-up sync for 48h. will include telemetry slices (gateway, runtime, auth, billing).

alex: thanks team. we'll keep this thread for the follow-up. tagging @sre-oncall for final sign-off once 5xxs are back to baseline. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: 5xxs at baseline now. leaving a note in incident tracker with timeline.

support-bot: Customer updates sent at 09:52 UTC.

alex: closing war-room for now. postmortem outline expected in ticket by EOD tomorrow.
